reforms.description: Saskatchewan announced a new corporate tax credit for research and development to support private-sector R&D investment.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: R&D tax credits reduce the effective cost of private R&D investment, incentivising firms to increase innovation spending and productivity.
reforms.status_evidence: Text states 'announced a new corporate tax credit'.
reforms.importance_rationale: A provincial tax credit is a narrower, incremental policy instrument affecting a single province's private sector.
reforms.source_quote: Saskatchewan announced a new corporate tax credit for research and development.

reforms.description: The federal government established the Canada Foundation for Innovation with up-front funding of C$800 million to support research infrastructure and innovation capacity.
reforms.package_name: Federal Innovation Infrastructure & Human Capital Programme (1997–1998)
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Investment in research infrastructure enhances the capacity and productivity of the public research system, supporting long-term innovation and knowledge creation.
reforms.status_evidence: Text states 'established' with up-front funding, indicating announcement and likely immediate implementation in 1997.
reforms.importance_rationale: Establishment of a major federal foundation with C$800 million in dedicated funding represents a structural, system-wide investment in research infrastructure capacity.
reforms.source_quote: the Canada Foundation for Innovation with up-front funding of C$ 800 million

reforms.description: Ontario announced a C$500 million ten-year research and development fund as part of its May 1997 budget to support research and development activities.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Direct public R&D funding increases research capacity and knowledge creation, supporting long-term productivity and innovation.
reforms.status_evidence: Text states 'announced' as part of May 1997 budget.
reforms.importance_rationale: A C$500 million provincial R&D fund is significant but narrower in scope than federal system-wide reforms; it is a substantial but regionally limited initiative.
reforms.source_quote: C$ 500 million for a ten-year research and development fund

reforms.description: The federal government announced the Canada Millennium Scholarship Foundation with C$2.5 billion in multi-year funding to provide 100,000 scholarships annually to low and middle-income students, supporting human capital development for higher education.
reforms.package_name: Federal Innovation Infrastructure & Human Capital Programme (1997–1998)
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Scholarships for higher education build the supply of skilled human capital, supporting long-term productivity and innovation capacity in the economy.
reforms.importance_rationale: A C$2.5 billion multi-year federal scholarship programme providing 100,000 scholarships annually represents a major, system-wide investment in human capital development.
reforms.source_quote: a C$ 2.5 billion multi-year Canada Millennium Scholarship Foundation which is to provide 100 000 scholarships a year to low and middle-income students
